qualified_parent: Y035 original first-use run38358624593 succeeded at pinned commit; moving original branch head excluded.
question: When only one motif remains live between episodes, can a locally inferred +2 shift justify rewriting all dormant associations, or does it induce harmful overgeneralization under a hidden sparse switch?
hypothesis: The exact single-live-overlap evidence at transition episode5->6 is compatible with both uniform +2 shift and a sparse +2 shift to that one overlapping motif. A global dormant correction should help in the uniform world but can harm in the sparse world.
freeze: This is a prospective distinct experiment on fresh seeds88..95. Freeze the paired-world construction, overlap motif, policies and outcomes before first-use; do not tune after observing heldout results.
generator: Base static 4-valued association is SHA256('Y033/'+seed+'/'+motif) first byte %4; 16 motifs, exactly seven current active from Y030 keyed schedule, 12 episodes. Define k*(seed) as unique motif shared between episode5 and episode6 (assert exactly1). UNIFORM: from episode6 all targets=(base+2)%4; SPARSE: from episode6 only k* target=(base+2)%4 and all other targets remain unchanged. k* is known only to evaluator/generator, NOT the policies.
arms: UNMODIFIED: read previous active and up to nine dormant observed key-values, update from current feedback only

LOCAL_GLOBAL_CORRECTION: same sources and cache capacity, but after observed active feedback infer a nonzero common delta using ONLY motifs live across consecutive episodes (one overlap). If consistent, adjust all dormant value estimates by that delta; count all maintenance updates.
sequence: At every episode predict seven target labels before feedback; reveal exactly those seven and update active/dormant caches (7 live+max9 dormant), then optionally repair dormant by delta; never expose future/hidden cue labels to inference policy.
validity: Preflight assert one live overlap at switch for every seed, eight unique SHA256 keyed source signatures, write and occupancy equality between arms, deterministic run twice, prereg/source parent blob check and one full regression.
metrics: Heldout correct predictions for episodes7..11, dormant-return correct, maintenance updates and evidence events under both paired worlds; per-seed regret for correction vs baseline. Report policy evidence at e6, but only evaluator knows counterfactual target labels.
primary: LOCAL_EVIDENCE_AMBIGUITY if globally-corrected policy improves total post-switch correct in UNIFORM condition and worsens it in SPARSE condition, while evidence at episode6 is identical for both conditions (one +2 overlap); MIXED otherwise. Any invalid overlap signature must be classified INVALID_GEOMETRY rather than retuned.
claim_limit: Indistinguishability only for a policy restricted to previously-live overlapping-cue evidence, NOT for an unrestricted observer with all current supervised feedback.
